Ronan.line: Ronan kneels a long moment beside the old wolf shrine, one knuckle to the worn stone. He says nothing. He does not have to.

Maeve Ashwood.line: In the rebuilt village Maeve sets down her Lantern of Ashes and lights it, watching the small flame steady against the dark for everyone she couldn't save.

Torren.line: Torren goes quiet among the forgotten dwarven stonework, tracing seams no living smith could cut, learning from the dead.

Corwin.line: Corwin sits cross-legged before the ancient carvings and sketches them faithfully, certain they are a sentence in a language he has not yet earned.

Talos.line: When the fighting is finally done, Talos climbs to the high ground alone and watches the sun come up over the ground they held.

Eleanor.line: Eleanor offers a silent prayer, head bowed, asking nothing — only naming the lost so that somewhere, something remembers them.

Ragash.line: Ragash sits on a fallen log and lets the wild come to them; by dusk the hounds are ringed by curious eyes that would flee from anyone else.
